verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms an official Python SDK ('nitrokey' 0.4.2 on PyPI) alongside the official pynitrokey/nitropy CLI, so desktop integration is possible. One community report also praises Nitrokey's dev tools and documentation, though that comment is about the HSM product. Missing for 10: any evidence of a mobile (Android/iOS) SDK, SDKs beyond Python, and documented SDK API references or integration guides.
